memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Insomnia
  - Status: New onset, difficulty falling asleep, ISI score 18 (moderate severity).
  - Plan: Start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Order TSH, haemoglobin, ISI repeat in 6 weeks. Advise sleep hygiene: limit caffeine after 14:00, screen-off 30 min before bed, keep bedroom cool.
- Weight: 58 kg
- Waist: 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm, within limit).
- Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Insomnia
  - Status: Improved sleep onset, ISI now 12 (mild). Mild morning grogginess reported.
  - Plan: Reduce trazodone to 25 mg HS, continue melatonin 3 mg HS. Repeat TSH, Hb, ISI in 6 weeks. Advise to take trazodone with a light snack to reduce grogginess.
- Weight: 57.5 kg
- Waist: 77 cm
- Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04

Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 25 mg HS

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Eye exam (Snellen): Visual acuity 6/6 both eyes. No retinopathy. Intraocular pressure normal. Advice: annual eye check due to prolonged screen time while driving.

memories.text:

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Messaged via app: "Sleeping better, only occasional early waking. No side effects now. Thanks."

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Insomnia
  - Status: ISI 8 (mild), reports restful sleep most nights.
  - Plan: Discontinue trazodone, continue melatonin 3 mg HS. Monitor for rebound insomnia. Repeat TSH, Hb, ISI in 3 months.
- Weight: 57 kg
- Waist: 76 cm
- Due: HbA1c not applicable.
